sections.title: Rates
sections.text: US 10-year 4.91% (-9 bp in a month), 2-year 4.63% (-6 bp); 2s10s curve +28 bp (-3 bp in a month). Yields are little changed on the month. T-bill yield 4.17% sets the cost of carrying inventory.

sections.title: Dollar & farm currencies
sections.text: Dollar index 103.83 (+2.0% in a month, +5.6% YTD). A stronger dollar makes US grain, oilseeds, cotton and meat dearer abroad. USD/BRL 5.893 (+16.7% in a month): a weaker real encourages Brazilian farmer selling of soybeans, corn, sugar, coffee and cotton, pressuring world prices. USD/CNY 6.654 (-0.4%); USD/MXN 19.41 (+3.7%); a sharply weaker peso cuts Mexico's buying power for US corn, pork, dairy and wheat (Mexico is the top buyer of all four).

sections.title: Risk appetite
sections.text: S&P 500 -5.5% in a month (+5.2% YTD); VIX 26.4. Risk-off: funds tend to cut commodity length along with equities.

sections.title: Energy
sections.text: WTI 81.69 $/bbl (-19.1% in a month), Brent 88.50, ULSD 3.654 $/gal (-21.9%), natural gas 3.67 (+4.7%). Lower crude weighs on soybean oil and corn through biofuel margins and on cotton via cheaper polyester.

sections.title: China & industrial demand
sections.text: Copper -17.1% in a month, Shanghai Composite -3.9%, Hang Seng -3.8%, yuan +0.4% vs USD. Soft China/industrial signals point to weaker import demand.

us_econ: Jobs: payrolls +165k in 2026-10 (3-month average +137k), unemployment 4.1% (-0.1), wages 3.1% y/y. Growth: real GDP 3.4% annualized in 2026-Q3, consumer spending 3.8%. Policy: fed funds target 3.75-4.0% (effective 3.88%); 2-year Treasury 4.63% (+0.75 vs fed funds: market pricing hikes); 10-year breakeven inflation 2.12%, real 10-year 2.79%. Farm prices (PPI farm products) +2.6% y/y. For ags: high real yields and a firm dollar weigh on fund demand for commodities; sticky inflation keeps rates high (carry and storage costs up); a weak job market or falling real incomes hits meat and dairy demand first.

energy.read: Gas storage 3,882 Bcf (week to 2026-11-13), +20 Bcf vs a 5-year average -25 for the week; +98 Bcf (+2.6%) vs the 5-year average, -54 vs last year. Crude stocks 417.8 mb (+3.4 mb on the week, -3.7% vs 5-yr avg); gasoline +5.2 mb, distillate +1.6 mb; refinery utilization 95.7%. 3-2-1 crack $37.82/bbl (ULSD $72.82, gasoline $20.32). NG weather/positioning: squeeze risk LOW (1 of 7 cold-risk checks on; managed money net -211,476 (2nd pct of 3 yrs, -54,628 in 4 wks)). GEFS AO week 2 -1.19 (now -0.04). No colder forecast trend; trade the fundamentals and the curve. Options: NG IV 83% vs RV 59%; CL IV 47% vs RV 52%; HO IV 50% vs RV 49%; RB IV 44% vs RV 43%. For ags: diesel and natural gas set farm fuel, drying and nitrogen fertilizer costs; crude and gasoline drive ethanol and biodiesel margins (corn, soybean oil).
